what: A guanidine-II riboswitch dimer (two chains of 18 nucleotides, the two hairpins) with a bivalent ligand between its two binding pockets: the first frame of a molecular dynamics system, with its hydrogens and without water. The test case for a ligand whose partner is RNA.
reference: Steuer J, Sinn M, Eble F, Rütschlin S, Böttcher T, Hartig JS, Peter C. Cooperative binding of bivalent ligands yields new insights into the guanidine-II riboswitch. NAR Genom. Bioinform. 2024, 6(3), lqae132. https://doi.org/10.1093/nargab/lqae132

ligand.name: bis-guanidine
ligand.smiles_from: read off the ligand's bonds and its 18 hydrogens in the model: 1,4-diguanidinobutane with both guanidines protonated. Not given by the source.
ligand.residue_name_note: BGD is the simulation's own name for the ligand. The PDB's chemical component of that name is another molecule.

contacts: interactions.tsv: PLIP 3.0.1 through bindview.detect.detect_interactions(receptor='nucleic'). With the receptor left at 'protein' PLIP finds 0 contacts here.
state: One guanidinium sits in the pocket of chain B; the other touches only the phosphate of A8 of chain A.
